projects.title: OpenRazer keyboard support
projects.summary: Added Linux support for the Razer Huntsman V3 HE Magnetic Tenkeyless 8KHz to OpenRazer's driver and daemon. Merged by the maintainers in November 2026.
projects.details: The keyboard uses the same protocol as a model OpenRazer already supported, so the change adds its device ID across the C kernel driver, the Python daemon, the udev rules and the device metadata: 84 lines across 7 files. Tested on Fedora with Polychromatic.

projects.title: SpeedySheets
projects.summary: Desktop tool that automates repeat Excel reports from reusable mapping templates.
projects.details: Started as a Python prototype. Now being rebuilt in C as a fast, self-contained program.

projects.title: TACO
projects.summary: Desktop app for curating CSV data row by row: fill empty cells or review every value, with guidance on screen.
projects.details: Pick a unique ID and the columns to review, then step through records in empty-cells-only or all-data mode. Curated output is saved separately from the source file.

projects.title: CatchAll
projects.summary: Self-hosted, open-source life planner. An AI coach breaks goals into small steps and fits them into open time on your calendar.
projects.details: Covers the areas people usually track in separate apps, like health, home, money and food, with every area optional. Currently in alpha as a ground-up 2.0 rebuild.

projects.title: Solo Guitar Arranger
projects.summary: Web app that turns sheet music into solo-guitar arrangements using language models.
projects.details: Pricing tiers map to model choice, from low-cost open-weight models up to Claude. Being tested with a guitarist before launch.

projects.title: Early-2000s style website
projects.summary: A site built in the style of early-2000s web design.
